analysis: Both sides took a real hit this week: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is officially out for Philadelphia, and Aaron Donald (back) is out for the Rams, who are also down CB Jaylen Watson and TE Terrance Ferguson. With both adjustments now priced in, the sim pulls the total down to 40.7 against a market of 45.5 -- a meaningfully bigger gap than before either injury was formal, and it nudges the margin slightly toward Philadelphia (model sees a near-pick em game against the Rams getting only +3.5).

The spread gap is still modest enough that this reads mainly as a total play: two offenses missing a notable piece (Rams twice over, between Donald up front and the receiving-corps attrition already in the data) in a game that was already projecting under before the news hardened.
